## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows gitflow (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, `docs/*`, `chore/*` → `develop`)
- [ ] PR title and commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): ...`)

- [ ] `./gradlew test lintDebug assembleDebug` passes
- [ ] New logic in `core/pure` has unit tests
- [ ] Comments in English; docs updated (translations too, if you can)
- [ ] Tested on an emulator or head unit (Android version: )
- [ ] No secrets (API keys, keystores) committed
